description: A vuln-exception-record artifact documents a time-bounded, approved exception for a known vulnerability with compensating controls and a named approver.

rules.description: Record must declare: id, vulnerability_id, affected_component, justification, mitigation_context, expiry_date, and approver.
expiry_date must be a future date no more than 90 days from the current date.
mitigation_context must describe real compensating controls in at least 30 characters — placeholder values (N/A, TBD, TODO) are rejected.
approver must be a real named individual (name or email) — system, automated, or placeholder values are rejected.
